entities.summary: Wilhelm Friedrich Karwinsky von Karwin was a Bavarian naturalist who collected plants and animals in Brazil (1821–1826) and Mexico. He was born in Keszthely, now in Hungary, and died in Munich. Many plants and animals are named in his honour, including the genus Karwinskia and the species Erigeron karvinskianus and Smyrna karwinskii.
